name: AmbientBadge
tagline: 为桌面通知角标加入玻璃质感与柔和光晕。
description: 微光角标为桌面通知角标加入玻璃质感与柔和光晕，提供胶囊、光环、悬浮光球、侧边胶囊、玻璃圆环、渐变光线、双斜线、渐变条、玻璃条、柔光脉冲条和圆点条十一种样式。
每种样式独立保存大小、模糊不透明度、位置和自定义文字颜色；支持从整张图标选择主要彩色区域，无法取得可靠颜色时使用经典红色。
沿用系统原生角标数量，数量增加可触发柔和脉冲；关闭插件后恢复系统角标。
features: 十一种角标样式：胶囊、光环、悬浮光球、侧边胶囊、玻璃圆环、渐变光线、双斜线、渐变条、玻璃条、柔光脉冲条和圆点条
自动跟随系统浅色与深色外观；启用自定义文字颜色时保留所选文字颜色
从整张图标提取主要彩色区域，无可靠颜色时回退红色；也可统一自定义颜色
每种样式独立设置数字文字颜色，默认关闭，关闭后恢复系统深浅模式配色
可调节外围环境光晕强度
每种样式分别保存 0–100% 模糊不透明度，不影响文字、描边和光晕
每种样式独立保存横向与纵向 −30～+30 pt 小数位移，滑块步进 0.1，位置归零仅影响当前样式
每种样式独立保存 50%～150% 整体缩放，文字、符号和光晕同步调整
位置支持最多两位小数的手动输入；大小与 模糊不透明度 同样支持滑块和数值输入
新通知或数量增加时可选单次柔和脉冲，并遵循系统“减弱动态效果”
保留 App 原有角标数量，大数量显示为 99+，关闭插件后恢复系统角标
优化图标动画跟随和首次显示时机，减少角标提前出现或与图标分离
简体中文、繁体中文和英文设置，保存后即时应用
修正设置页首次进入时的标题显示及桌面翻页时的角标异常闪现
四款顶部条形独立设置是否显示数字，默认关闭；圆点数量固定，不代表未读数量
双斜线采用圆弧玻璃底、右下模糊斜边与增强光晕，多位数字自动适配
柔光脉冲条支持柔和呼吸，遵循动画开关与系统“减弱动态效果”
usage: 安装后打开“设置 → 微光角标”并开启插件。
从十一种角标样式中选择一种，并按需设置应用配色、自定义颜色和环境光晕强度。
进入当前样式的设置页，调整大小、模糊不透明度和位置；需要时开启“自定义文字颜色”并选色。位置归零只影响当前样式的位置。
选择顶部条形后，可在当前样式设置中开启“显示数字”；关闭数字时保留已选文字颜色。
拖动滑块后松手应用，或点击数值手动输入位置、大小和 模糊不透明度；位置支持最多两位小数。
按需开启通知脉冲；所有设置保存后即时生效。
notice: 给我的朋友:Billie。最低要求 iOS 15；更高系统版本及不同主题、动画组合的兼容性仍需按实际设备确认。

changes: 新增双斜线、渐变条、玻璃条、柔光脉冲条和圆点条，共十一种样式。
新增样式独立保存大小、位置、模糊不透明度和文字颜色；四款顶部条形可分别开关数字显示，保留已有设置。
双斜线采用圆弧玻璃底与右下柔化斜边，增强光晕并留出数字间距；柔光脉冲条支持呼吸动画，遵循动画开关与“减弱动态效果”。
优化整图取色，优先识别有足够占比的彩色主体，无可靠颜色时回退经典红色。
新增各样式独立的自定义文字颜色，关闭后恢复系统深浅模式配色。
修正设置页标题首次显示与翻页角标闪现问题，取消系统最高版本限制，最低仍为 iOS 15。
新增悬浮光球、侧边胶囊、玻璃圆环和渐变光线，连同胶囊与光环共六种样式。
新增独立样式设置页，每种样式分别保存大小、Blur Opacity 和位置；保留旧数值与小数精度，位置归零仅影响当前样式。
优化图标动画跟随和首次显示时机，减少角标提前出现或与图标分离，并完善三语言文案与版本显示。
修复部分环境下偏移移动跨度异常、微调位置却移动过大的问题。
修复打开应用再返回桌面后，角标位置跳变、前后不一致的问题。
胶囊与光环两种样式同步修复，保留已有位置设置和小数精度，无需重新调整。
新增小数位移，支持更精细的角标位置调整。
滑块步进改为 0.1，手动输入支持最多两位小数。
保留原有偏移范围、单位和已保存设置，升级后无需重新调整位置。
新增胶囊与光环两种玻璃角标样式，支持系统深浅外观、应用/自定义配色和环境光晕。
新增独立 Blur Opacity、位置、大小与手动数值输入，设置保存后即时生效。
新增通知脉冲、原生角标计数与 99+ 显示，并支持三语言设置和“减弱动态效果”。

en.name: AmbientBadge
en.tagline: Give notification badges a glass appearance and a soft ambient glow.
description: AmbientBadge gives Home Screen notification badges a glass appearance and soft ambient glow, with eleven styles: Capsule, Orbit, Floating Orb, Side Pill, Glass Ring, Gradient Line, Double Line, Gradient Bar, Glass Bar, Soft Pulse Bar, and Dot Bar.

Each style saves its own size, blur opacity, position, and custom text color. Colors are selected from substantial colored areas across the whole icon, with a classic red fallback when no reliable color is available.
It preserves native badge counts, can pulse gently when counts increase, and restores system badges when disabled.
en.notice: Made by Banana, for Billie. Requires iOS 15 or later; compatibility with newer iOS versions and individual theme or animation combinations still needs confirmation on the relevant device.
features: Eleven styles: Capsule, Orbit, Floating Orb, Side Pill, Glass Ring, Gradient Line, Double Line, Gradient Bar, Glass Bar, Soft Pulse Bar, and Dot Bar
Automatic system Light and Dark appearance, with the chosen text color preserved when its custom option is enabled
Whole-icon color extraction with a red fallback, or one unified custom color
Independent custom count-text colors for each style, disabled by default; turning off restores system appearance colors
Adjustable ambient glow intensity
Independent 0–100% Blur Opacity for each style without fading text, outline, or glow
Independent decimal horizontal and vertical offsets from −30 to +30 pt for each style, with 0.1 slider steps and a reset that affects only the current style
Independent 50%–150% overall scaling for each style, including badges, text, glyphs, and glow
Manual position input with up to two decimal places, plus slider and numeric input for size and Blur Opacity
Optional single pulse for new or increased badge counts, respecting Reduce Motion
Native badge counts with 99+ display and system-badge restoration when disabled
Improved icon animation following and first-display timing to reduce early or detached badges
Settings in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese with immediate application
Corrected initial settings-page titles and abnormal badge flashes during Home Screen paging
Independent Show Number toggles for all four top-bar styles, disabled by default; the fixed dot count does not represent unread counts
Double Line with a rounded glass backing, a soft diagonal lower-right edge, stronger glow, and fitted multi-digit counts
Gentle Soft Pulse Bar breathing that respects the animation toggle and Reduce Motion
usage: Open Settings → AmbientBadge after installation and enable the tweak.
Choose one of the eleven badge styles, then configure app colors, a custom color, and ambient glow intensity as desired.
Open the selected style's settings to adjust size, blur opacity, and position, or enable Custom Text Color and choose a color. Reset Position affects only that style's position.
For a top-bar style, enable Show Number in its style settings if desired. Hiding numbers keeps the chosen text color saved.
Release sliders to apply changes, or tap values to enter position, size, and Blur Opacity manually; position accepts up to two decimal places.
Optionally enable notification pulses; saved settings apply immediately.

changes: Added Double Line, Gradient Bar, Glass Bar, Soft Pulse Bar, and Dot Bar, bringing the total to eleven styles.
New styles save size, position, blur opacity, and text color independently. Each top-bar style has its own number toggle, while existing settings are preserved.

Double Line features a rounded glass backing, a soft diagonal lower-right edge, stronger glow, and more room for numbers. Soft Pulse Bar supports breathing animation, respecting the animation toggle and Reduce Motion.
Improved whole-icon color extraction, favoring substantial colored areas and falling back to the classic red when no reliable color is available.
Added independent custom text colors for each style; disabling the option restores system Light and Dark appearance colors.
Fixed initial settings-page titles and badge flashes during Home Screen paging, and removed the upper iOS version limit while retaining iOS 15 as the minimum.
Added Floating Orb, Side Capsule, Glass Ring, and Gradient Light, for six styles including Capsule and Orbit.
Added per-style settings with independent size, Blur Opacity, and position; existing values and decimal precision are preserved, and position reset affects only the current style.
Improved icon animation following and first-display timing to reduce early or detached badges, and completed trilingual text and version display.
Fixed excessive offset movement in some environments, where small adjustments moved badges too far.
Fixed badge position changes after opening an app and returning to the Home Screen.
Applied the fix to Capsule and Orbit while preserving saved offsets and decimal precision, with no readjustment required.
Added decimal offsets for finer badge positioning.
Changed slider steps to 0.1 and added manual input with up to two decimal places.
Preserved the existing offset range, units, and saved settings, so no position readjustment is needed after updating.
Added Capsule and Orbit glass badge styles with system appearance adaptation, app or custom colors, and ambient glow.
Added independent Blur Opacity, position and size controls, and manual numeric input with immediate application.
Added notification pulses, native badge counts with 99+ display, trilingual settings, and Reduce Motion support.
